in the pressure match.  Bourdet et al modified the Gringarten tD/CD type curve to 
include the dimensionless derivative response as shown in Figure 22.  If the Laplace 
transform of the pressure response is ~pWD, predicted by equation (29) for example, 
then the Laplace transform of the derivative is simply:
 
~p´WD = s ~pWD

be computed using (75) and this has been included in the log-log type curve shown in 
Figure 22.  For each dimensionless pressure curve, referring to a particular value of 
the parameter CDe2S, there is a corresponding derivative curve of characteristic shape.
